newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinians say Israeli police beat them.
newsitem.headline: Palestinians say Israeli police beat them.

text.p: Israeli border police beat three Palestinians on Monday during a clash in the Israeli-controlled area of Hebron in the West Bank, one of the victims said.
Hebron's Alia hospital said the men were bruised and one of them may have a broken finger.

The Israeli border police were unavailable for comment. Israel security sources said the confrontation occurred during a routine security check when a Palestinian punched a border policeman in the face.
"We were standing near our house when one of the soldiers came and asked for my identity card. He looked at it and then for no reason hit me," said Chadi al-Avrami, 18.

"I started yelling at the soldier why are you hitting me. Other soldiers came and when I tried to escape they pinned me to the ground and continued to hit me with their guns and kick me," Avrami told Reuters.

Israel handed over 80 percent of the volatile city to Palestinian rule in January under an interim peace deal with the Palestinians. Israeli troops remain in the rest of the city, holy to both Moslems and Jews, to guard some 400 Jewish settlers in the town's heart.
